question: Is Phase 1 worth starting? Decided on the contrast cross-tab and the primary-endpoint intersection n.

contrast_crosstab_74_within_patient_pair.note: contrast resolved study-wide (all series in each study, not just the segmented one); recovery over series-level gained only 1 study

verdict: DO NOT START PHASE 1 AS PRE-SPECIFIED. The primary endpoint requires acquisition discordance, <=90 day spacing, AND verified contrast concordance simultaneously; only 5 patients (7 pairs) satisfy all three, giving MDE d=1.53 -- roughly 15% of mean volume, above the 10% kill threshold the criterion is written against. The endpoint cannot reach its own threshold. Option B (n=17) is only reachable by assuming 17 unknown/unknown pairs share a protocol, and among pairs where contrast IS verifiable 36% (95% CI 14-65%) are discordant, implying ~6 silently confounded pairs in that set. Contrast is not a nuisance here: it is a large-effect confounder for chamber segmentation.
options_for_the_arm: Reframe the endpoint away from absolute volume to a contrast-insensitive measure and re-derive the intersection.
Report the guardrail firing on the intersection count as the arm's result -- the safeguard refusing to run is the demonstrable instance.
Widen the cohort beyond the 4 TCGA collections to recover contrast-concordant repeat imaging.

rescue_design.name: within-study reconstruction pairs (same acquisition, different reconstruction)
rescue_design.confirmed_by: identical FrameOfReferenceUID plus identical AcquisitionTime or AcquisitionNumber; 234/234 tags fetched, 0 errors
rescue_design.why_it_works: Contrast, cardiac phase, anatomy, patient position and time are identical by construction because both series are reconstructions of the SAME irradiation event. The contrast confound that reduced the cross-study endpoint to n=5 cannot arise. No BSA normalization needed.
rescue_design.limitation: Isolates RECONSTRUCTION sensitivity, not full acquisition sensitivity - it cannot speak to scanner-to-scanner or protocol-to-protocol variation, which the cross-study design would have covered. This must be stated as the scope of the claim.

download_sizing.note: Series are shared across pairs; distinct-series count is a set union, not pairs*2 or pairs/2.
download_sizing.staging: Mandatory. 2.8 GiB free-disk ceiling vs 20.2 GiB total -> per-series download/segment/discard, peak ~200 MiB, resumable.

expression_matching.verdict: Dropping expression-matching does not rescue the cross-study endpoint; the binding constraint is the contrast field, not cohort size. Not recommended for that purpose alone.

revised_verdict: Phase 1 IS worth starting, but on the within-study reconstruction design (n=58 kernel / n=28 thickness), not the pre-specified cross-study paired endpoint (n=5). The cross-study endpoint is reported as halted by the intersection guardrail.

artifact_corrections.defect: download estimate stated as '~118 series', derived by halving the 234-series pull; series are shared across pairs so halving is invalid
artifact_corrections.scope: step-3 data-transfer sizing only; design, n, and MDE unaffected
artifact_corrections.fix: counted set union of ua/ub over the 193 confirmed pairs = 217 distinct series, 20.2 GiB; staged transfer now stated as mandatory
